{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Midweight wool-blend blazer, structured lapel cut, knee-length silhouette, charcoal grey (#36454F), woven tweed fabric with a subtle herringbone pattern.
Slim-fit cotton poplin blouse, tailored yoke and button-down front, hip-length hem, crisp white (#FFFFFF), smooth sateen weave.
Tailored wool trousers, straight-leg cut with a slight break at the shoe, full-length drape, forest green (#2E4C39), heavy gabardine fabric with natural crease retention.
Leather loafers, penny-cap design with minimal branding, ankle height coverage, matte black (#000000), supressed calfskin leather.
Thin silk scarf, rectangular cut with fringed edges, loosely draped length around the neck, rust orange (#E07A5F), 100% mulberry silk.

This outfit works because it strikes the perfect balance between professional polish and autumnal warmth without appearing too heavy for an office setting. The textured tweed blazer adds visual interest against the crisp white blouse and solid-colored trousers, creating a sophisticated monochromatic harmony that reads as "smart" rather than overly formal. While the weather is cool enough to warrant a jacket, the choice of natural fibers like wool and silk ensures comfort and breathability throughout the day. Completing the look with classic loafers grounds the ensemble in timeless style while allowing for easy movement between meetings and casual moments."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":491,"output_tokens":303},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
